title: Sanguine (血刃) - Stats, Combo & How to Get (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: Sanguine (血刃) in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.

facts.label: Special property

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sanguine (血刃) is a one-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. The starting blade and the root of the Tempering tree - every Sanguine-family transformation is built from it, which is why the starting weapon stays relevant.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Sanguine (血刃) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as One-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not publish a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons, and no measurement of this one has been recorded, so no damage, scaling or speed figure is given here. A number invented from how the weapon looks is exactly the kind of filler this page exists to avoid.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content:
The reason to carry it is its property rather than a damage number: Tempers into Infernal Rouge at level 5.

Switching to it mid-combo refills stamina, so its practical job is to extend a chain past the point where the blade you were using runs dry. See the combat system for how the swap window works.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Story reward - the starting blade.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page tracks Sanguine (血刃) in Phantom Blade Zero. Anything marked “not confirmed post-launch” has not been published or measured yet; see the weapons list for the system as a whole.
